timeline.text: Welcome to After Making a Mistake at Work. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I made a mistake and I feel panicked.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep replaying what happened.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am worried about what people will think.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to hide from this.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is reacting like everything is at risk.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am being very hard on myself.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I wish I could undo the moment.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel embarrassed.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This mistake feels bigger than it may be.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can pause before I respond.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: A mistake is information, not my identity.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can separate the facts from the panic.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can take responsibility without attacking myself.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can ask for help if I need it.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I only need to find the next useful step.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: Repair can be simple and honest.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can carry less shame into this response.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am capable of addressing what happened.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can speak clearly and directly.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can learn without defining myself by this.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I trust myself to make a thoughtful repair.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My worth is not decided by one moment.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can tolerate an imperfect workday.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I know how to take the next step.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can move forward with integrity.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: This mistake does not get the final word.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
